title: platform-objects: deleting a business unit that has children silently turns them into tenant roots — parent_business_unit_id declares no deleteBehavior and takes set_null
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207, the maintainer's browser round on ObjectStack 18.0.0 (「hotcrm 升级到 objectstack 18.0 然后重新安排一轮浏览器测试」). Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-04** of track 2 (the Setup pass as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01BkRPwuAufrFwoEEfuigDm9`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `16c28664` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-v18-setup-pass` at `4d7cc467d` ([`REPORT.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md)), which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → People & Org → Business Units.
- **Steps:**
  1. Create "QA EMEA", then "QA EMEA Office" with Parent = QA EMEA (the Org Chart shows the tree).
  2. Delete QA EMEA from its row menu.
- **Expected:** the delete is refused while children exist, or its confirm names what it does to the tree. The field's own help reads "Self-reference for the org tree. Null = root of tenant", and the Sharing Rules recipient type "Business unit and subordinates" reads that tree.
- **Actual:** the confirm reads only `Delete Business Unit "QA EMEA"? Are you sure you want to delete this record?`. After `200`, `GET /api/v1/data/sys_business_unit` shows `QA EMEA Office` with `parent_business_unit_id = null`: it is now a root of the tenant, without a word.
- **Evidence:** [`09-people-business-units-org-chart.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/09-people-business-units-org-chart.png) (before), [`09-people-business-units-delete-parent-confirm.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/09-people-business-units-delete-parent-confirm.png), [`09-people-business-units-delete-parent-result.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/09-people-business-units-delete-parent-result.png).
- **Reach:** every admin restructuring business units. A `unit_and_subordinates` grant anchored above the deleted unit no longer reaches its former children. That is lost reach, not added access.

## Seat review (source at 18.0.0, `06cab4849`)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit.object.ts:131-136`: `parent_business_unit_id: Field.lookup('sys_business_unit', { required: false, … })` declares no `deleteBehavior`.
- A lookup with none defaults to `set_null` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2981`), which the engine applies (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:19341`). The engine also honours an authored `restrict` on a lookup (`:19330-19331`).
- No hook refuses the delete. plugin-sharing has only after-write grant recomputes (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/bu-tree-recompute.ts:303`).
- The console's confirm is the generic one and has no server data about children.
- Unchanged on `main`.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24932) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13268), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-19`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Different, closed: objectstack#22957 (a `tree`-typed field's deleteBehavior was not honoured; this is a `lookup`, and `set_null` is honoured); objectstack#9625 (an explicit `set_null` on a required lookup); objectstack#7807 (subtree semantics of the recipient type).
- **New.**
